input_transform: Crop only padding using supplied input valid mask; publisher-normalized float intensity quantized to8bit with max absolute error0.5/255. No resizing, enhancement or target access.
output_transform: Each direct predicted polygon is filled by deterministic Pillow ImageDraw.polygon; later polygons overwrite overlaps. Padding stays0. This geometry decoder does not infer objects or fit any model.
protocol: Custom direct-image protocol, not a claim of official SynAPSeg leaderboard replication.
